tools.name: knowledge_destinations
tools.description: Find writable knowledge bases for explicitly saving a task result. Search by query or request successive pages while hasMore is true. Does not read documents or change task retrieval selection.

query.description: Search names, IDs or ownership. Maximum 200 characters.

page.description: Page number starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

size.description: Results per page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: knowledge_save
tools.description: Save content as a new Markdown document only when the user explicitly asks to save a task result. Choose an exact writable ID from knowledge_destinations. Save to a department or company base only when the user explicitly chooses that destination. Do not save automatically, change ownership, or change task selection. Indexing continues after saving.

knowledgeBaseId.description: Writable knowledge base ID chosen by the user.
